## Locked recipe (RAMP, verified vs paper p8 + upstream be4971f)
- **Schedule:** SGD, **lr 0.05 for epochs 1–70, then 0.005 (×10 drop) for 71–80**, momentum 0.9,
  weight_decay 5e-4. (RAMP `--lr-schedule=static`; our `milestones:[70]` = exact match.)
- **Epochs:** 80. **Save every 10** → epoch curves for ALL methods (needs trainer save_freq — FLAG 1).
- **Training inner-max attack:** **uniform 10/10/10** (RAMP `--at_iter 10`). Changed from 10/10/20.
- **eps:** (8/255, 0.5, 12), **train == eval**.
- RAMP-only method params (not ours): λ (KL weight), β=0.5. **FLAG 4: our RAMP repro used λ=5; paper
  cites λ=2** — Table-5 cross-check (42.9=42.9) says λ=5 reproduces RAMP faithfully; reconcile before
  citing. λ is irrelevant to our methods (no KL term).

## Attack-step policy (F1-safe — documented, do not violate)
| use | attack | steps (linf/l2/l1) | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| **TRAINING inner-max** | PGD (source) | **10 / 10 / 10** | RAMP-matched, uniform |
| **EVAL — develop/screening** | APGD, n=1000 | **l1 ≥ linf/l2** (never fewer) | fast iteration; l1 must never be shortchanged (our own F1) |
| **EVAL — final claim rows** | **full AutoAttack** | CE+T+FAB+Square to convergence | matches RAMP; APGD-only reads ~1.5pp high (why our RAMP repro 46.1 > paper 44.6) |
- **Training uniform-10 does NOT make eval uniform.** Eval keeps l1 ≥ linf/l2.
- Current `base.eval_attack` = APGD 100/100/100 (l1 not shortchanged, F1-safe) — used for RAMP repro;
  keep for screening consistency. Final rows switch to full-AA.

## Two-phase plan
### PHASE 1 — DEVELOP, stop at epoch 50 (pre-drop), **1 seed** each
All methods @ RAMP recipe, **epochs 50** (lr 0.05 flat — the drop is at 70, so ep≤50 is constant 0.05 =
same pre-drop state as RAMP ep_50), save every 10, train==eval@8/255, training attack 10/10/10.
Methods: **reactive T=0.25 · predictive CARD-PB v2 (population-aware miss + adaptive OFF, FIXED) ·
avg_frozen · 3a · β-ablation {0.3,0.5,0.8}**.

**Run order (de-risk first):**
- **5070ti (serial; needs measured FLOPs):** (1) reactive → (2) **predictive v2** ← *DE-RISK POINT:
  read the efficiency verdict here* → (3) β-ablation *only if predictive survives (2)*.
- **Colab (accuracy-only, parallel, Kiet runs):** (4) avg_frozen ∥ (5) 3a.

**Compare at ep_50:** internal efficiency (predictive vs reactive, same recipe + budget) + vs **RAMP
ep_50 = 42.9** (same recipe, same pre-drop state — apples-to-apples).

**Selection rule (1 seed = SCREENING, not claim-bearing):**
- top-2 within **1pp** at ep_50 → ranking may be seed-noise → run 1–2 extra seeds for those two to break the tie.
- winner leads **>2pp** → carry only it.
- Efficiency verdict: **FLOPs ratio RELIABLE at 1 seed** (mechanical); **Δunion PRELIMINARY** (seed
  variance) → escalate the reactive-vs-predictive pair to **3 then 20 seeds** to confirm "within noise".

### PHASE 2 — FINAL, continue to epoch 80, **3 seeds** for the winner
- **Continue** the winner from its ep_50 checkpoint, SAME schedule (lr 0.05 → drop 0.005 at 70 → ep 80).
  Valid continuation (ckpt@50 is at lr 0.05, same trajectory, not a hybrid) — **requires resuming
  optimizer+epoch+RNG state (FLAG 2: trainer not yet epoch-resumable).**
- Final comparison vs **RAMP ep_80 = 46.1**, **full AutoAttack** for the claim rows.

## Consistency notes
- **ALL methods use RAMP recipe + training 10/10/10.** No mixing with old our-recipe or 10/10/20.
  Efficiency = predictive vs reactive under the **same recipe + same training budget**.
- **FLOPs comparison UNAFFECTED by the lr change** (recipe changes lr schedule only, not attack budget).
  Uniform-10 training → **reactive budget = 30 steps**; predictive allocates within/below → still cuts
  attack-FLOPs vs reactive. (New FLOPs denominator = 30, was 40.)
- **Save every 10 → epoch curves for ALL methods** → F7 story for the whole cluster, not just RAMP.
- **Eval stays l1-heavy (F1-safe)** even though training is uniform-10. Final claim rows use full AA.

## Implementation FLAGS (before launch)
1. **save_freq**: add periodic (every-10) checkpointing (trainer saves best+last only now).
2. **resume**: Phase-2 continuation needs optimizer/epoch/RNG restore (not yet supported).
3. **l1 step_size @ 10 steps**: raised 0.05→0.10 to preserve reach; verify l1 training strength on the first reactive run.
4. **λ reconcile**: RAMP reference λ=5 (ours, Table-5-validated) vs paper λ=2 — decide before citing RAMP.
